en.name: Truffle oil
en.summary: Unopened truffle oil keeps 6–12 months from purchase in a dark cupboard, and 3–5 months once opened, or about 4 months refrigerated after opening. The aroma goes long before the oil does — and a bottle holding real truffle shavings follows different, stricter rules.
en.pantry: 6–12 months from purchase sealed and upright, in a dark cupboard away from the hob, and 3–5 months once opened. Almost all commercial truffle oil is an ordinary oil carrying a synthesised aroma compound — 2,4-dithiapentane, the molecule responsible for most of what people recognise as truffle — rather than any truffle at all, so it keeps exactly as the base oil does. Heat, light and air age it, but the aroma is the first thing to go: the volatile compound escapes every time the cap comes off, and a bottle a year old often smells of nothing but oil. Rancidity, the stale crayon smell, is the separate and later failure. These figures are read across from olive and vegetable oils.
en.fridge: About 4 months after opening at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, which slows the oxidation. Olive-based truffle oils go cloudy and semi-solid in the fridge and clear again at room temperature, which is harmless. Refrigeration is worth it in a hot kitchen and pointless in a cool one. There is one case where it is not optional: if your bottle contains actual pieces of truffle, garlic or herbs, it is no longer an aromatised oil but a low-acid food under oil, and mixtures of that kind kept at room temperature carry a risk of botulism. Such a bottle belongs in the fridge for no more than a few days, or in the freezer, and the pantry figures above do not apply to it.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for truffle oil, and freezing a plain aromatised bottle is pointless: oil does not set solid, and the aroma loss you are fighting happens through the cap rather than because of warmth. Freezing is, however, the safe long-term option for an oil that holds real solids — truffle, garlic, herbs — which cannot be kept at room temperature at all.
en.thawing: Let a chilled bottle stand at room temperature until it is clear and pours freely. Do not warm it on the hob, and do not try to accelerate a cloudy bottle with hot water.
spoilage: No truffle aroma when the cap comes off — the commonest and earliest failure.
A stale crayon or paint-like smell, which is rancidity of the base oil.
A bitter, scratchy finish at the back of the throat.
Cloudiness that does not clear at room temperature, or any bubbling in a bottle containing solids, which means it goes out immediately.
tips: Buy the smallest bottle you can; the aroma fades fast once opened.
Add it at the very end, off the heat — cooking drives the aroma straight off.
Store upright in the dark, away from the hob.
A bottle with truffle or garlic pieces in it is a refrigerated food, not a pantry one.

faq.q: How long does truffle oil last?
faq.a: 6–12 months from purchase unopened, 3–5 months once opened, or about 4 months refrigerated after opening. The aroma usually fades before the oil goes rancid.

faq.q: Why does my truffle oil not smell of truffle any more?
faq.a: The aroma compound is volatile and escapes each time the bottle is opened. That is a separate and much earlier failure than the oil going rancid.

faq.q: Is an oil with real truffle or garlic pieces in it safe on the shelf?
faq.a: No. An oil holding pieces of a low-acid food carries a botulism risk at room temperature. Keep it refrigerated for no more than a few days, or freeze it.

zh.name: 松露油
zh.summary: 未開封的松露油自購買日起放暗處可放 6～12 個月，開封後是 3～5 個月，冷藏則約 4 個月。香氣會在油本身壞掉之前很久就先跑光——而一瓶裡面泡著真松露片的油，適用的是另一套更嚴格的規則。
zh.pantry: 未開封密封直立、放遠離爐火的暗櫃，自購買日起 6～12 個月；開封後 3～5 個月。市售松露油幾乎都不是用松露做的，而是一般食用油加上合成的香氣分子——2,4-二硫雜戊烷，大家認得的「松露味」大半來自它——所以它的保存就跟基底油完全一樣。熱、光和空氣會讓它老化，但最先消失的是香氣：那個揮發性分子每開一次蓋就跑掉一些，一瓶開了一年的松露油常常只剩油味。油耗（那股陳蠟筆味）則是另一個、而且更晚才發生的失敗。這些數字是比照橄欖油與植物油讀過來的。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下約 4 個月，可以拖慢氧化。以橄欖油為基底的松露油在冷藏會變濁、半凝固，回到室溫就恢復，這是無害的。在炎熱的廚房裡冷藏值得，在涼爽的廚房裡則沒有必要。但有一種情況不是選項而是必須：如果你的瓶子裡有真正的松露片、蒜瓣或香草，那它就不再是「加香的油」，而是「泡在油裡的低酸食品」，這類混合物放在室溫下有肉毒桿菌中毒的風險。這種瓶子只能冷藏、而且不要超過幾天，或者直接冷凍；上面那些常溫數字不適用於它。
zh.freezer: 松露油沒有公布的冷凍期限，而單純的加香油冷凍也沒有意義：油不會凍成硬塊，而你要對抗的香氣流失是從瓶蓋跑掉的，不是溫度造成的。不過對於裡面真的泡著固形物（松露、蒜、香草）的油來說，冷凍才是安全的長期選項，因為那種油根本不能放在室溫。
zh.thawing: 把冰過的瓶子放室溫，等它恢復清澈、倒得順即可。不要拿去爐火上加溫，也不要用熱水去催變濁的那瓶。
spoilage: 開蓋聞不到松露香——最常見、也最早出現的失敗。
聞起來像陳蠟筆或油漆味，那是基底油油耗了。
入口後喉頭有苦味和刮喉感。
回到室溫仍然混濁；或裝有固形物的瓶子出現冒泡，那要立刻丟掉。
tips: 買你買得到最小的瓶裝；開封後香氣消失得很快。
最後離火再淋——加熱會把香氣直接趕走。
直立、避光、遠離爐火存放。
泡著松露片或蒜瓣的那種瓶子是冷藏食品，不是常溫食品。

faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 6～12 個月，開封後 3～5 個月，冷藏約 4 個月。香氣通常在油變質之前就先褪掉。

faq.q: 我的松露油為什麼不香了？
faq.a: 那個香氣分子很容易揮發，每開一次瓶就跑掉一些。這和油本身油耗是兩回事，而且來得早得多。

faq.q: 裡面泡著真松露或大蒜的油可以放常溫嗎？
faq.a: 不行。油裡泡著低酸食材在室溫下有肉毒桿菌風險。請冷藏、而且不要超過幾天，或者冷凍保存。
